posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform OpenAI researchers show small doses of "beneficial trait" training make AI models broadly safer and harder to manipulate The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 3h ago • OpenAI shows targeted reinforcement learning on behavioral traits improves model safety across domains. • Training on health data improved deception detection in tested models. • Approach scored better on 44 of 53 benchmarks without extensive additional training.
